fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.explain_en: Plane trees line Huaihai Road and give wide shade.
questions.explain_zh: 淮海路两旁常见梧桐，树荫很宽。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 11 sparrows sit on a plane tree. 9 fly away. How many stay?
questions.q_zh: 梧桐树上有 11 只麻雀，飞走了 9 只，还剩几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A zongzi stall sells 7 parcels in the morning and 2 in the afternoon. How many parcels in all?
questions.q_zh: 粽子摊上午卖了 7 只，下午卖了 2 只，一共卖了几只？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: An e-bike has ____ wheels.
questions.q_zh: 电动车有几个轮子？
questions.explain_en: A typical e-bike has two wheels.
questions.explain_zh: 常见电动车有两个轮子。
questions.qtype_zh: 简单机械（轮子/车铃/刹车）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: There are 14 zongzi on the plate. The family eats 2. How many are left?
questions.q_zh: 盘子里有 14 只粽子，一家人吃了 2 只，还剩几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: One dragon boat has 10 paddlers, another has 8. How many more on the first boat?
questions.q_zh: 一条龙舟上有 10 名桨手，另一条有 8 名，第一条多几名？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The zongzi stall tickets are numbered 6, 8, 10. What is the next number?
questions.q_zh: 粽子摊的取号是 6、8、10，下一个号码是几？

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: Chinese measure word: 一____粽子 (one zongzi). Which word fits?
questions.q_zh: 量词填空：一____粽子。
questions.explain_en: People often say 一只粽子.
questions.explain_zh: 粽子常用“只”：一只粽子。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: In Lujiazui, the tall modern towers stand across the river from the ____.
questions.q_zh: 在陆家嘴，高高的新楼和____隔江相望。
questions.explain_en: Lujiazui faces the Bund across the Huangpu.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴和外面的外滩隔着黄浦江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海地标（陆家嘴/外滩/新天地）

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: At the Bund, Flora sees old buildings on one side and the ____ on the other.
questions.q_zh: 在外滩，Flora 看见一边是老大楼，另一边是____。
questions.explain_en: The Bund has historic buildings on one side and the Huangpu on the other.
questions.explain_zh: 外滩一边是老大楼，一边是黄浦江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: Flora rides her e-bike to the Xintiandi door. The doorman hands her a warm ____.
questions.q_zh: Flora 骑电动车来到新天地门口，礼宾递给她一只热的____。
questions.explain_en: The doorman welcomes her with a warm zongzi.
questions.explain_zh: 礼宾用一只热粽子迎接她。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, the doorman stacks 2 warm zongzi on the left tray and 3 on the right tray. How many zongzi does he stack?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地，礼宾左边托盘放了 2 只热粽子，右边放了 3 只，他一共放了几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 9 warm zongzi sit at the Xintiandi door. The doorman hands out 6 of them. How many zongzi are still on the tray?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口放着 9 只热粽子，礼宾送出了 6 只，托盘上还剩几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On the Bund, 16 green flags and 8 gold flags fly for the boat race. How many more green flags than gold ones are there?
questions.q_zh: 外滩为龙舟赛挂了 16 面绿旗和 8 面金旗，绿旗比金旗多几面？
questions.qtype_zh: 比较相差（多多少/高多少）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, Flora counts 7 trays of 10 zongzi and 8 single zongzi. How many zongzi is that?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在新天地数到 7 盘粽子（每盘 10 只）和 8 只单独的粽子，一共多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Dragon boats lining up by the Bund are numbered 11, 15, 19 in a pattern. What number is on the next boat?
questions.q_zh: 外滩边排队的龙舟按规律编号：11、15、19，下一条龙舟是几号？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At Xintiandi, Flora opens her pouch and finds 2 five-yuan notes and 3 one-yuan coins to buy zongzi. How many yuan are inside?
questions.q_zh: 在新天地，Flora 打开零钱袋，看到 2 张五元和 3 个一元硬币要买粽子，里面一共多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 5 pentagon-shaped flags on a dragon boat by the Bund. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在外滩的龙舟上看见 5 面五边形的旗子，它们一共有几条边？
